newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Senate approves motorbike incentive scheme.
newsitem.headline: Italy Senate approves motorbike incentive scheme.

text.p: The industry commission of the Italian Senate (upper house) approved a government draft law on Thursday that offers discount incentives to Italians to trade in old motorcycles and motorbikes, parliamentary sources said.
The bill, which will now go to the lower house for approval, also contains provisions for aid to small and medium-sized businesses.

Under the plan, owners of mopeds, motorbikes and three wheeled vehicles built before 1989 will be entitled to discounts from manufacturers and the state if they buy new models during a specified period. The old models will have to be scrapped.
A similar scheme is already in force for automobiles.
The proposed state price discounts are 300,000 lire for a moped and 500,000 lire for a motorbike, matched by the same amount in the form of a manufacturer's discount.
